top_stories.title: Congress tries moving MLAs to Karnataka – in vain – as Meenakshi Natarajan’s Rajya Sabha nomination is rejected | Political Pulse News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: The **BJP** secured a victory in the Rajya Sabha election after rejecting the nomination of **Congress** leader Meenakshi Natarajan. The rejection came after the BJP challenged her nomination, alleging incomplete disclosure of information related to a court case.  Despite attempts by the **Congress** to move its legislators to Karnataka to avoid potential influence from the BJP, the decision was made and the party's candidate was ultimately rejected. The **BJP** celebrated the victory while the **Congress** condemned the decision as an attempt to undermine democracy.

top_stories.title: ‘50-year demand’ nears fulfilment as Zojila tunnel breakthrough brings Ladakh closer to all-weather connectivity | India News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Ladakh** MP Hanifa Jan and **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, along with **Union Road Transport and Highways Minister Nitin Gadkari**, celebrated a breakthrough in the Zojila tunnel, which will connect Ladakh to Kashmir year-round.  The project has long been sought after by **Ladakh**'s leadership and was crucial during the 1999 Kargil conflict when road access was limited due to heavy snowfall. The tunnel is expected to boost economic growth, improve connectivity, and ease travel for residents, particularly those in remote areas like Kargil.  The breakthrough has been hailed as a historic milestone by religious and social organization Jamiat Ul Ulama Isna Asharia Kargil, who have long campaigned for year-round connectivity.

top_stories.title: Blackmailed over intimate photos and fake suicide note, Mangaluru businessman loses Rs 2.77 crore | Bangalore News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: A **Mangaluru businessman** was blackmailed into paying over Rs 2.77 crore by two individuals, **Jitesh** and **Nizam Ibrahim**, a **Youth Congress** leader.  The extortion began in June 2024 when **Jitesh** threatened to circulate intimate photos online unless the businessman paid a ransom. **Ibrahim** later allegedly used a purported suicide note from **Jitesh** to pressure the businessman into further payments, totaling Rs 2.57 crore between June 2024 and January 2026.  Both men have been remanded to judicial custody while police investigate. The **Youth Congress** expelled **Ibrahim** following his arrest.

top_stories.title: Frequent disruptions in legislatures pose a serious challenge to democratic institutions: Om Birla - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Om Birla**, Speaker of the Lok Sabha, emphasized that frequent disruptions in legislative institutions pose a challenge to democratic principles. He urged **state and central legislatures** to promote conduct aligned with public expectations and meaningful discussion. The second conference of the **Commonwealth Parliamentary Association (CPA) India Region Zone-II (North Zone)** concluded with four resolutions aimed at making legislative institutions more effective, accountable, and people-centric.  These resolutions are expected to contribute to the progress of parliamentary and democratic institutions in India.

top_stories.title: Why Norway and Scotland are embroiled in war of words before World Cup
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Norway** and **Scotland** are engaged in a heated exchange of words following the cancellation of a planned friendly match between the two teams due to an injury to **Billy Gilmour**. **Stale Solbakken**, **Norway's** head coach, criticized **Scotland's** decision, calling it unprofessional. **John McGinn**, **Scotland's** captain, defended his team's actions, stating that their priority is to look after their players and suggesting that **Norway** should have done more research before commenting on the situation.

top_stories.title: Vijay to attend NITI Aayog Governing Council meeting in Delhi - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **C. Joseph Vijay**, Tamil Nadu's Chief Minister, will attend the 11th Governing Council meeting of **NITI Aayog** in New Delhi on Thursday.  He is scheduled to meet with political leaders in New Delhi before participating in the council meeting alongside other state and UT chief ministers and lieutenant governors. This marks his second visit to the national capital since becoming Chief Minister.

top_stories.title: ‘Humiliation, mental cruelty drove woman to take her life’: Court refuses to quash ‘dowry death’ case | Legal News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: The **Karnataka High Court** refused to quash a dowry death case against a man and his parents, noting allegations that the victim was subjected to ridicule and told she did not deserve to live when she complained about difficulties in her marriage. The court found evidence of alleged cruelty, including humiliation and mental distress, leading up to the victim's suicide six months after her marriage.  The court rejected arguments that no overt act had occurred before death and left open the possibility of further legal action against the husband's family.

top_stories.title: UP, Bengal top Centre’s Rs 95,692-crore interim allocation for states under VB-G RAM G | India News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: **The Centre** announced an interim allocation of Rs 95,692.31 crore for the Viksit Bharat Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) Act 2025 to states, with **Uttar Pradesh** receiving the highest share at Rs 9,721.48 crore. The allocation is based on last year's expenditure under the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme (MG-NREGS).  **Union Rural Development Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan** emphasized that the scheme aims to ensure no worker remains unemployed and will be implemented with strict adherence to statutory rights.

top_stories.title: US Begins Strikes Against Iran After Tehran Downs American Apache Chopper
top_stories.rephrased_article: Following the downing of a US Army Apache helicopter off the coast of Oman, **President Donald Trump** blamed **Iran** for the incident and vowed a US response.  The US military launched strikes against Iran in retaliation, marking the first known drone sea rescue by the American military. The two aviators aboard the downed helicopter were rescued by a drone boat and later picked up by a helicopter. This incident further strained an already fragile ceasefire between **Iran** and the United States, which was established after months of escalating tensions.  The conflict has also impacted global economies and energy prices.

top_stories.title: RSS’s labour union highlights social security coverage, AI concerns at ILO conference - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Bharatiya Mazdoor Sangh (BMS)**, a labor wing of the **Rashtriya Swayamsewak Sangh (RSS)**, urged international collaboration to ensure that artificial intelligence benefits workers rather than replaces them.  **Bojji Surendran**, BMS delegate at the 114th International Labour Conference in Geneva, highlighted India's high social security coverage and called for governments and institutions to focus on decent work opportunities. He also expressed concern over conflicts affecting labor mobility and urged trade unions to promote dialogue during such times.
